title: Elux Legend Oasis Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Oasis Nic Salt combines the sweet and tart flavours of ripe Raspberry, juicy Blueberry, and luscious Strawberry into one vibrant and refreshing vape. This berry medley delivers a perfectly balanced and fruity flavour profile, making it an ideal choice for fans of bright and lively blends. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold, intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. With a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide fast-acting nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, ensuring a satisfying and flavoursome vape experience. Mixed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Oasis Nic Salt is designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is a versatile and flavourful choice for adult smokers and vapers.
